{{Quote|What have you learned for me, little mouse?|Muerdo, to a mouse droid|<ref name="Legacy 49" />}}
'''Muerdo''' was an [[Utai/Legends|Utai]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] under the employ of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime-lord [[Vedo Anjiliac Atirue]].<ref name="Legacy 49" /> In [[138 ABY]],<ref name="Date">Although the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Legacy (2006) 49|''Legacy'' (2006) 49]] states that its events take place in [[137 ABY]], the more recently released [[Star Wars: Legacy Volume 10: Extremes|''Star Wars: Legacy: Extremes'' trade paperback]] dates those events to [[138 ABY]].</ref> Muerdo used a [[MSE-series|mouse droid]] to learn of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]]'s presence on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. Muerdo passed the information to Atirue, who in turn gave it to the [[One Sith]], hoping to lure the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]] into a trap.<ref name="Legacy 49" />
